title: Layered menu
description: A compact archive navigation slides between category and subcategory panels without multiplying popovers.
useCase: Navigate a small hierarchy inside one continuous disclosure surface.
interaction: Open a category, drill into a group and choose a collection.
reducedMotion: Hierarchy changes are immediate, preserving the same focus and back actions.
limitations: A two-level local collection selector. It uses disclosure buttons rather than application-menu semantics.
look: Pale grey page with a thin top nav of two text dropdowns and a white rounded panel listing categories with grey glyphs, subtitles and arrows.
motion: Choosing a category slides a two-page track left in 240 ms with a strong ease-out to show subcategories; the back button reverses it; the panel opens without animation.
adapt: The drill-down is `lm-track` (two `lm-page` panes at 200% width) toggled by `data-deep` with a 240 ms transform transition; `level` picks the subgroup and focus moves in `useLayoutEffect`. Replace `groups` with your hierarchy; keep `inert` on the hidden pane and `data-still`.
